name: Sunken Treasure
summary: Fleet Master Seahorn, whose ships cannot sail from Booty Bay until they restock, asks you to carry a secret letter to Shakes O'Breen, busy off the Arathi coast.

sections.title: A Letter for O'Breen
sections.body: Fleet Master Seahorn sizes you up as the adventurous sort. His ships cannot leave Booty Bay until they have restocked, and he says heavy things are brewing both here and abroad. He needs top secret correspondence carried to Shakes O'Breen off the Arathi coast, and he asks whether he can trust you to deliver the message safely and in confidence.

faq.q: Who sends you to deliver this letter?
faq.answer: Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay gives you a sealed letter for Shakes O'Breen.

faq.q: Why doesn't Fleet Master Seahorn deliver the letter himself?
aliases: why can't seahorn leave booty bay
why is fleet master seahorn stuck
faq.answer: His ships cannot sail from Booty Bay until they have restocked.
Off the coast of the Arathi Highlands, where Seahorn says he is busy.

aliases: what quest comes before sunken treasure 5
faq.answer: It follows the fourth part of Sunken Treasure.
